verdict: CUSUM simulation. The single-generation probe (tau=0.35) fires on the chronic drift with probability only 0.0088 even at the PEAK drift rho_inf=0.09 (k=10) -> it provably misses the chronic regime. A cross-generation CUSUM DOES detect it: at lambda=0.15, in-control ARL=130 generations while expected detection delay EDD=7.6 generations (det-rate 1.00) -> ARL >> EDD, a usable detector. This backs the §6 claim empirically: the per-generation probe misses the sub-threshold drift, CUSUM catches it within tens of generations at a controlled false-alarm rate.
